portfolio.title: Quizmaster
portfolio.description: Ett quiz med flera olika kategorier byggt som en Single Page Application med JavaScript, HTML och CSS, med fokus på interaktivitet, användarupplevelse och responsiv design.
portfolio.descriptionEn: A quiz application with multiple categories built as a Single Page Application using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with focus on interactivity, user experience, and responsive design.

portfolio.title: Hittarecept
portfolio.description: En receptapp byggd med React, Tailwind CSS, React Router och MealDB API, med fokus på dynamisk datahantering, responsiv design och en smidig användarupplevelse.
portfolio.descriptionEn: A recipe application built with React, Tailwind CSS, React Router, and the MealDB API, with focus on dynamic data handling, responsive design, and a smooth user experience.

portfolio.title: Konnect ChatApp
portfolio.description: En modern chattapplikation byggd med React, Vite och Tailwind CSS, med fokus på API-anrop, CRUD-funktionalitet, sessionshantering och en responsiv användarupplevelse.
portfolio.descriptionEn: A modern chat application built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, with focus on API requests, CRUD functionality, session handling, and a responsive user experience.

portfolio.title: Namngivelse inbjudan
portfolio.description: En responsiv webbplats byggd med React, Vite och Tailwind CSS, med fokus på modern design, användarupplevelse och formulärhantering via Formspree.
portfolio.descriptionEn: A responsive website built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, with focus on modern design, user experience, and form handling through Formspree.
